headline: Mooring County Work Falls; Weathered Expanse Still Heaviest Ground
war_summary: The Mooring County line has shifted since the last edition: a Colonial force has taken one work in that sector, leaving the Wardens eleven of twelve against a single Colonial holding, with eight actions logged in two hours and the latest entered at 08:45. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's heaviest ground, now four Warden works, two Colonial and three unclaimed, forty-three actions in the past day and the longest casualty tables on the map, with a fresh event standing at this packet's cutoff. Callahan's Passage has awakened at Crumbling Post, four actions within two hours and six on the day, with works captured and others reduced to no-man's-land, the Wardens retaining nine of ten. Linn Mercy is unchanged in outline at ten Colonial works and one unclaimed, though its firing has cooled. The Nevish Line has gone quiet in the last two hours after ten actions in six, holding at six Colonial works against two Warden. Stonecradle stands at eight Colonial works and one Warden. Marban Hollow remains near-even at four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed. The map overall stays predominantly Colonial, with Warden strength massed in the north and west.
